editorial:
You step into a dark crime story where a psychic doctor named John Clancy helps an FBI agent track a serial killer. The movie mixes mystery with mind-reading tension, so you always feel like the next clue is hiding in plain sight. Anthony Hopkins brings a calm, sharp energy to Clancy, while the investigation pulls you through strange crime scenes and personal secrets. It is not a loud action movie; it is more of a slow-burn thriller that keeps you guessing about who is really in control.

The acting is the biggest draw, especially Hopkins, and the story has a few clever turns that make you rethink earlier scenes. Some parts feel familiar if you have seen many serial killer thrillers, and the pacing can drag in the middle. Still, if you enjoy crime mysteries with a psychic twist, this is a solid weekend pick. You can stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for the best picture.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, you learn the killer shares Clancy’s psychic gift and has been choosing victims to end their suffering before it gets worse. Clancy confronts him and uses one last vision to outsmart him. The killer is finally stopped, and the case closes, but Clancy is left shaken by how close their minds really were.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves crime thrillers with a psychic twist.
